sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.content: When you use GameHub, we may collect the following types of information: Personal information you provide when registering (such as username and email address); Content you create while using the platform (such as game reviews, comments, and posts); Your gaming preferences and usage behavior data; Device information and technical data.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use the collected information for the following purposes: To provide, maintain, and improve GameHub platform services; To personalize your experience; To communicate service updates and important notices; To analyze usage trends and optimize platform features; To ensure platform security and user rights.

sections.title: Information Sharing
sections.content: We do not sell your personal information. We may share your information in the following circumstances: With your explicit consent; When required by law; To protect the rights and safety of GameHub users; With trusted service providers who are bound by confidentiality agreements.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.content: We implement industry-standard security measures to protect your personal information, including SSL/TLS encrypted transmission, data storage encryption, access control mechanisms, and regular security audits. Please note that no data transmission over the internet can be guaranteed as completely secure.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information. You can exercise these rights through your account settings or by contacting our support team. We will respond to your requests within a reasonable timeframe.

sections.title: Policy Updates
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes through website announcements or email. Your continued use of GameHub constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

sections.title: Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By using GameHub, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any term, please stop using our services. We reserve the right to modify these terms at any time, and changes take effect immediately upon posting.

sections.title: Account Responsibility
sections.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials, including your password. You are fully responsible for all activities that occur under your account. Notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

sections.title: User Conduct
sections.content: You agree to comply with all applicable laws when using GameHub. You may not post illegal, harassing, abusive, defamatory, or infringing content. You may not use the platform for any fraudulent activity or to distribute malware.

sections.title: Intellectual Property
sections.content: All rights to the GameHub platform itself belong to GameHub. You retain ownership of content you post on the platform, granting us a license to display and distribute it. You may not copy, modify, or distribute platform content without permission.

sections.title: Disclaimer
sections.content: GameHub is provided on an "as is" basis without any warranties, express or implied. We are not responsible for user-generated content and do not guarantee uninterrupted or error-free service. To the fullest extent permitted by law, we disclaim all liability.

sections.title: Termination
sections.content: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your account if you violate any terms. You may terminate this agreement at any time by ceasing to use the service. Certain provisions will survive termination.

sections.title: What Are Cookies
sections.content: Cookies are small text files stored on your device that remember your preferences and browsing information. When you visit GameHub, we may place cookies on your device to enhance your experience.

sections.title: Types of Cookies We Use
sections.content: Essential Cookies: Required for the platform to function properly, no consent needed. Functional Cookies: Remember your language preferences and login status. Analytics Cookies: Help us understand how users interact with the platform. Preference Cookies: Store your personalization settings.

sections.title: Third-Party Cookies
sections.content: We may allow authorized third-party service providers to place cookies on your device. These third-party cookies are governed by their respective privacy policies. We do not control the use of these third-party cookies.

sections.title: Cookie Management
sections.content: You can control cookie usage through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to block or delete cookies. However, disabling certain cookies may prevent some platform features from functioning properly.

sections.title: Our Pledge
sections.content: GameHub is committed to fostering a friendly, inclusive, and respectful community environment for all users. We pledge to ensure everyone can participate in community activities in a harassment-free environment, regardless of age, gender, race, religion, sexual orientation, or identity.

sections.title: Expected Behavior
sections.content: Encouraged behaviors: Respect others' viewpoints, engage in constructive discussion, share useful content, help new users. Prohibited behaviors: Personal attacks, harassment, discriminatory言论, posting inappropriate content, spamming, revealing others' privacy, impersonation, spreading misinformation.

sections.title: Content Guidelines
sections.content: All content must comply with applicable laws and community standards. Prohibited content includes pornography, violence, terrorism, hate speech, and other illegal material. Game reviews should be objective and fair. Reposted content must credit the original source.

sections.title: Enforcement
sections.content: Violations of the Code of Conduct will result in appropriate measures depending on severity, including but not limited to: warnings, content removal, feature restrictions, temporary suspension, or permanent account ban. Serious violations may be reported to law enforcement.

sections.title: Reporting
sections.content: If you encounter any violations of the Code of Conduct, please report them using the report function or by contacting our support team. We take every report seriously and will investigate and take action within a reasonable timeframe.

why.title: Why Cozy Games Are Taking Over
why.content: The cozy gaming trend has exploded in 2026, with searches for 'cozy' on Steam surging 675%. These games offer a sanctuary from high-stress competitive titles, providing players with relaxing mechanics, soothing soundtracks, and welcoming communities. Whether you're farming, decorating, or exploring at your own pace, cozy games prioritize your wellbeing over winning.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.a1: Cozy games prioritize relaxation, gentle gameplay, and positive emotions over challenge or competition. Common features include farming, crafting, decorating, exploration, and relationship-building — all at your own pace.
faq.q2: What are the best cozy games for beginners?
faq.a2: Stardew Valley is the perfect starting point. Animal Crossing: New Horizons, Unpacking, and Dorfromantik are also excellent choices with gentle learning curves.
faq.q3: Can I play cozy games on PC?
faq.a3: Most cozy games are available on PC (Steam, itch.io), Nintendo Switch, and modern consoles. Many are also available on mobile platforms.
faq.a4: Many cozy games offer multiplayer modes. Palia is a free MMO cozy game, Animal Crossing supports island visits, and Stardew Valley has co-op farming.

future.title: The Future of AI Gaming
future.content: By 2026, AI has become the most transformative force in gaming. From NPCs that remember your choices to worlds that generate themselves based on your play style, AI is making games more personal, immersive, and replayable than ever before. The line between scripted experiences and living worlds is blurring.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q0: How is AI used in modern games?
faq.a0: AI powers NPC behavior, procedural content generation, dynamic difficulty adjustment, voice recognition, and personalized gaming experiences. Modern games use AI for everything from enemy tactics to generating entire worlds.
faq.a1: Yes! AI can generate unique character portraits, voices, personalities, and backstories. Tools like GameHub's Character Portrait 3D let you create AI-powered game characters.
faq.a2: AI NPCs are non-player characters powered by language models and behavior trees. Unlike traditional scripted NPCs, they can hold natural conversations, remember past interactions, and adapt their behavior dynamically.
faq.a3: No — AI is a tool that empowers developers to create richer experiences. It automates repetitive tasks and enables new forms of gameplay, but human creativity remains essential for game design.
